- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Pet generation progress tracker screen: Insert a dedicated progress tracking screen before waiting finishes to show live visual updates and setup tips. (why: Home waiting step mean time is extremely long (2336s), indicating users get lost or think the app hung during pet generation.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Path selection decision helper tip: Add a clear recommendation tip guiding hesitant users to choose the preset pet path quickly. (why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, showing severe long-tail decision paralysis.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background pet readiness notification status: Display background status updates and enable ready alerts on the waiting screen. (why: Users abandon or leave the app idling for over 38 minutes on average during pet generation.)
3: [adoption, copy] Photo upload quality guidance tip: Add explicit photo quality recommendations and clear photo guidelines on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in troubleshooting delay tip: Display a timed hint providing connection advice if the user hesitates on sign in. (why: Support noted sign-in screens occasionally stalling or failing to open.)
